## Problem

What pain point or missing capability are you trying to solve? A clear
description of *why* this matters helps more than a speculative feature list.

## Proposed solution

Describe the idea concretely:

- What user-facing behavior would change?
- Rough API/UI surface (endpoints, fields, screens) if known.
- Which existing pattern it should follow (pool, key, provider spec, pricing,
  logs, …).

## Alternatives considered

What else did you try or consider?

## Additional context

Links, diagrams, links to a provider/API docs you want supported, mockups, etc.
